SPEAKER_SETUP_INTRO: To add or change a speaker, put it in pairing mode, find it, then select it below.
DISCOVERY_INTRO: Choose the Bluetooth audio device Volumio should remember and connect. Selecting a device does not change where music plays.
CHOOSE_SPEAKER_NOTE: Before changing Bluetooth devices, return to the default audio output. Then choose a device and select Select and connect. Other audio devices remain paired. Route playback to Bluetooth again when ready.
CHOOSE_DEVICE_NOTE: For a new device, put it in pairing mode before searching and keep its pairing light flashing until Select and connect finishes. Some devices may need their Bluetooth button pressed again. Connection can take several seconds while the audio stream becomes ready.
FIND_ANOTHER_NOTE: Your current speaker remains saved unless another speaker connects successfully.
RESET_SPEAKER_SETUP_NOTE: Returns to the default audio output and clears this plugin's saved-device setup. System Bluetooth pairings are preserved for other plugins.
RESET_PLUGIN_SETUP_NOTE: Returns to the default audio output and clears only this plugin's saved device, codec preferences and routing state. System Bluetooth pairings are preserved.
FIND_SPEAKERS_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Pairing mode is needed only for a new device.
CURRENT_OUTPUT_NOTE: Bluetooth loudness may be controlled by Volumio software volume, Bluetooth stream volume and the receiving device's own volume. Keep headphones off until setup is complete and you have confirmed a safe level.
AIRPLAY_INTRO: Find an AirPlay receiver on this network, choose it and save it. Selecting a receiver does not change where music plays.
SEARCH_FOR_AIRPLAY_NOTE: The receiver must be awake, on the same network and configured to allow AirPlay without a password. This plugin's own Volumio receiver is excluded.
CHOOSE_AIRPLAY_NOTE: Save the receiver you want to use, then choose Play through selected AirPlay receiver above. Switching output is manual and stops playback. Once connected, pause, resume, track changes and seeks keep the AirPlay session open.
AIRPLAY_RECEIVER_VOLUME_NOTE: Applied by the sender when an AirPlay session starts. It is separate from Volumio software volume and the receiver's own output level. Start low and keep headphones off until the level is confirmed.
BLUETOOTH_DEVICE_VOLUME_NOTE: Local BlueALSA digital gain for the selected stream. It is not necessarily the device's physical volume.
BLUETOOTH_STREAM_VOLUME_NOTE: Controls the digital audio level sent by BlueALSA, separately from the device's own controls. A normal switch to Bluetooth starts at 10% for safety. Applying a codec change uses the level entered here.
SAVED_SPEAKER_NOTE: Reconnect or disconnect the selected device, remove a system Bluetooth pairing, or clear only this plugin's setup. If a paired device will not reconnect, press its Bluetooth button until its pairing light flashes, then retry.
FORGET_SPEAKER_NOTE: Removes the selected system Bluetooth pairing, including for other software that uses it. The device may be switched off. Pairing mode will be required to add it again. Other pairings are not affected.
AUTO_RECONNECT_NOTE: Attempts to reconnect the selected device when it becomes available. It never routes music automatically and does not provide fallback.
BLUETOOTH_SOUND_NOTE: Choose a codec and Bluetooth stream volume together. If Bluetooth output is active, a codec change stops playback, applies both settings and keeps Bluetooth selected; press Play afterward.
PREFERRED_CODEC_NOTE: Saved separately for each device. Automatic chooses the best mutually available codec. On the active Bluetooth output, Apply codec and volume changes and verifies it immediately; there is no need to return to the default output.
DIAGNOSTICS_NOTE: Status refresh, diagnostics and logging for troubleshooting.
DEBUG_LOGGING_NOTE: Enable only while investigating a problem; additional details are written to the Volumio log.
SCAN_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Audio-capable devices are listed first when BlueZ reports their profile.
CREATE_OUTPUT_NOTE: Available only when device diagnostics confirm BlueALSA. This never installs a competing audio stack or edits MPD directly.
MANUAL_OUTPUT_NOTE: Switching output stops playback. Press Play when the switch completes. Default output returns to the device already selected in Playback Options.
